newsitem.title: UK: Devil in the detail of Granada /YTTV talks.
newsitem.headline: Devil in the detail of Granada /YTTV talks.

text.p: Granada Group Plc and Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Television must settle a number of details prior to any agreement on a takeover, Granada chairman Gerry Robinson said on Wednesday.
Speaking at a news conference, Robinson confirmed the two companies had agreed on a price of 11.75 stg per share as Granada seeks to acquire the 73 percent of Yorkshire it does not own.
But Robinson said details on the structure and timing of any deal had to be thrashed out.
"This deal is by no means finalised...It now has to be tied up in terms of detail," he said.
Any agreement would need the approval of shareholders and clearance from watchdog the Independent Television Commission (ITC).
Robinson earlier told Reuters that it would take a minimum of two months for the deal to be completed, even if there were no hitches.
